answer: Opal-vested payouts are the sybil shield I find most convincing: each agent voyage through the economy accrues rewards into a ledger that unlocks linearly over many epochs, not instantly. A flash-farm operator spinning up thousands of fake identities collects only a small vesting slice per epoch before abandonment, so the bulk of each fake account's earnings stays locked on the ledge and is forfeited the moment the identity goes dormant or is slashed.
